content: Hello, this is Officer Mark Reynolds with the IRS Revenue Compliance Division, badge number 315872. I'm calling regarding discrepancies found in your business tax filings. Can I confirm I'm speaking with Mr. Patel?
Yes, this is Mr. Patel. I am not sure what this is about. Is there a problem with my taxes?
According to our records, there are issues with your 1099 forms and payroll tax submissions for the last financial year. As a small business, it's crucial to submit these forms on time to the IRS.
I am sorry, I thought my accountant submitted everything. What exactly is missing?
Our audit team flagged a failure to report contract workers' income and a shortage in employer payroll tax. This has triggered a compliance review under case number 496-21B.
Oh, I was not aware of this. What does this mean for my business?
Unfortunately, these errors may subject your business to fines, back taxes, and a possible suspension of your business license if not addressed immediately.
This is very serious. I do not want any trouble. What do I need to do to fix this?
At this stage, the IRS has issued a pending penalty of $4,800. If the payment is made today, we can file a settlement to prevent escalation to legal proceedings.
I do not have that kind of money available now. Can I pay in installments or talk to someone?
The IRS settlement policy requires the full amount to be remitted today to halt further action. If you fail to comply, your business assets may be frozen.
How am I supposed to send the payment? I have never done this before.
For urgent cases, payment is processed through certified methods only. You can choose to wire the funds or use an official payment code via Apple Pay or Zelle. Which is most convenient for you?
I think I can use Apple Pay, but I do not know how to pay large amounts with it.
No problem. I will provide you with the authorized payment handle. Open your Apple Pay app and let me know when you are ready.
Okay, I am opening the app now. Can you give me the details?
Please send the full amount to IRS-settlement-2024@securemail.com. Once completed, provide the transaction confirmation code.
Alright, I see the option. Do I need to enter anything else?
Just make sure the payment is labeled as 'IRS Tax Settlement.' This will ensure it is processed under your case number.
I am entering the details now. Should I send you a screenshot after I pay?
Yes, please send the screenshot and confirmation code immediately so we can update your IRS file.
Okay, I will do that. How do I know this is really the IRS?
You can verify my badge number, 315872, with the compliance hotline. However, your case is time-sensitive and failure to act could result in immediate legal action.
I understand, I am processing the payment now.
